claims.statement: The word χάραγμα is itself a numismatic term. It is the standard Greek word for the *impression* on a coin — the stamp of the die that makes raw metal into legal currency. The coin's χάραγμα is what transforms substrate into authorized tender. When Revelation transfers χάραγμα from the coin to the body, it makes the operative-numismatic logic explicit: the beast stamps bodies as a mint stamps metal. The body becomes the coin. The subject becomes the substrate.
